//: Codex's effective `plugins` feature under each argv, measured on codex-cli 0.159.2 with `codex features list <args>` under an empty CODEX_HOME: `-c features.plugins=` last-wins among itself, then any `--enable plugins`, then any `--disable plugins`, both toggles applied after every `-c`. One source for two readers: the mock codex's model (`codex_plugins_enabled`, tests/support/mock_harness.rs, held to it by its unit test) and the live phase `oh_codex_feature_flag_order` (scripts/e2e-lib.sh), which asks real codex every row. oneharness's plugins-off default `-c features.plugins=false` rests on it: a caller's later `-c features.plugins=true` or any `--enable plugins` must still win. The same rows with `plugins` spelled `apps` are Codex's `apps` feature, which oneharness turns off the same way (`-c features.apps=false`): the live phase asks real codex both, and the mock's `codex_feature_enabled` is held to both by its unit tests.
